name: Hindustan Agrigenetics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Hindustan Agrigentics Ltd is in the business of processing and trading in seeds[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
HAGL was set up for development, production and marketing of seeds, tissue culture and floriculture. Company's main product Sunflower Hybrid Seed was adversely hit during liberalization of the economy, under which import of oil palm was allowed and the acreage 
of Sunflower seed came down by 90%. Floriculture, a new business was adversely 
 hit due to inadequate cold storage facility 
 at the airports. Currently,  company is in the process of identifying and developing new products based on digital technology to provide information needs of farmers

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 31.2%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -15.9% over past five years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -4.07%
Working capital days have increased from 3,535 days to 11,543 days
